fun_fact: Every September, California's black bears enter "hyperphagia" — a pre-hibernation feeding frenzy to pack on calories. As Los Angeles suburbs push into the Angeles National Forest, these adaptable omnivores are increasingly drawn to human trash, pools and fruit trees, making 2026 a record-setting year for bear encounters. [Read more](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/20/los-angeles-bear-coexistence)
